control_oracle.rule: the same gate as the background-on oracle, at this one count (no count search)

defined_rule: not every row of the window clipped at 0.05, nor every row at 0.95
rule: the smallest count at which, at every depth, the planted-band crossovers of A and B agree within 1 contact in every defined window where both find one; a defined window where exactly one finds one is indeterminate (null, no localization measure, counted at every count); picked-band crossovers, bands and edge shifts are uncertainty only
z_units: 0-based contact index; null where undefined or absent
